mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS applyId, c.id AS resultId, e.empl_nm AS counselorName, a.type_cd AS counselingType, c.cnsl_cn AS resultContent, c.cnsl_dttm AS counselingDateTime, a.aply_dttm AS applyDateTime FROM cnsl_aply a LEFT JOIN empl_info e ON a.empl_no = e.empl_no LEFT JOIN cnsl_rslt c ON a.cnsl_aply_id = c.cnsl_aply_id WHERE c.id = #{resultId}
